title: feat: add account settings
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Adds self-service account settings and deletion to the Enter dashboard.

This PR builds on the merged #13564, which introduced the GitHub-scoped quest reward keys and database migrations. This PR contains the account UI, deletion flow, legal copy, and integration coverage.

- Adds an Account page with GitHub profile details, a copyable Pollinations ID, and a danger zone for account deletion.
- Adds Account and Sign out actions with package UI icons, including closing the mobile drawer after navigation.
- Uses Better Auth hard deletion for the account, sessions, credentials, balances, API keys, and user-owned resources.
- Enforces a session created within the previous ten minutes before deletion.
- Preserves only the orphaned GitHub-scoped reward idempotency records supplied by #13564, preventing a replacement account from receiving the same quest reward again. Replacement accounts see those quests in the normal claimed state without receiving a claimable reward or including the old pollen in their totals.
- Adds concise Terms and Privacy acknowledgement at sign-in and aligns the legal text with active-system deletion, temporary cache retention, billing records, and backups.
- Tests deletion cascades, reward retention, re-registration with the same GitHub identity, duplicate reward prevention, fresh-session enforcement, and the 50-Pollen purchase quest.

Addresses #13547

gist.headline: The exit has a door
gist.blurb: The Enter dashboard now has a proper account desk: your GitHub profile, a copyable Pollinations ID, and a clearly marked way to leave. Deletion clears the active hive while keeping quest receipts from mysteriously blooming twice.
gist.summary: Added a self-service Account page in Enter with GitHub profile details, a copyable Pollinations ID, sign-out controls, and a fresh-session-protected hard deletion flow that removes accounts, sessions, credentials, balances, API keys, and user-owned resources.
gist.impact: Users can now manage or permanently delete their Enter account themselves after signing in within the last ten minutes, while GitHub-scoped quest reward records safely prevent a replacement account from claiming the same reward twice.
